title: Elder Tech Support Pop-Up
scenario: A pop-up says the computer is infected and gives a phone number to call.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.
answers.D: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.

explanation: Elder Tech Support Pop-Up: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
proTip: Close the browser and contact trusted support.
